accent-text.$description: A darker shade of the orange accent for text: 6.0:1 white · 5.1 on --accent-faint · 4.6 on --accent-ring. --accent is 3.6:1 on white.

accent-solid.$description: Solid fill under a white label: --accent is under 4.5:1 with white (green 3.8, orange 3.6), so buttons, checked controls and progress use the darker --accent-2.
